ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT made as of the Iday of November, 2006 by and between ST. THOMAS CHURCH IN THE CITYOF NEW YORK, a New York religious corporation ("Lot 37 Owner"), with an office at 1 West 53"d Street,New York, New York 10019 and BROADWAY TRIO LLC,a Delaware COuNT 800 Third Ave.,Fourth Floor, New York, NY 10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street addresses 217-221 West 57th Street and 216 West 58th Street, designated as Lots 19 and 43 in Block 1029 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Developer Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the "Developer Building," and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the“Developer Premises"); WHEREAS,Lot37Owner is theowner ofcertainland,withthebuildingsand improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan,generally known by street address as 202-206West58thStreet,NewYork,NewYork,designated as Lot 37in Block 1029on theTaxMapof theCityof NewYorkandmoreparticularlydescribedonExhibit B annexedheretoandmade apart hereof(saidlandbeinghereincollectivelycalled the“Lot 37 Land,”said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Lot 37 Building,” and the Lot 37 Land and the Lot 37 Building being herein collectively called the“Lot 37 Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building (the“New Developer Building") on a development site located on a zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) which will include Developer's Premises (the “Development Site") with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the Lot 37 Land which are not utilized by the Lot 37 Building (the "Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS,(i) by Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Lot 23 Declaration"), made by and between American Fine Art Society ("Society") and Developer, dated December9,2005,and recorded on January 17,2006 at CRFN No.2006000026685 in the Tax Lots 19, 23 and 43 in Block 1029 on the Tax Map were declared to be“one zoning lot”as 1 KL.3 2553532.2
